name: @repo/css-modules-kit
description: Runs css-modules-kit's codegen for the CSS modules in the monorepo. Its own package because css-modules-kit needs the TypeScript 6 compiler API (`@typescript/typescript6`, aliased as `typescript` here), which the TypeScript 7 the rest of the repo runs on does not ship.

scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:themer && pnpm run generate:translations-tab
